title: DirMixE: Harnessing Test Agnostic Long-tail Recognition with Hierarchical Label Variations
abstract: arXiv:2405.07780v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper explores test-agnostic long-tail recognition, a challenging long-tail task where the test label distributions are unknown and arbitrarily imbalanced. We argue that the variation in these distributions can be broken down hierarchically into global and local levels. The global ones reflect a broad range of diversity, while the local ones typically arise from milder changes, often focused on a particular neighbor. Traditional methods predominantly use a Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) approach, targeting a few fixed test label distributions that exhibit substantial global variations. However, the local variations are left unconsidered. To address this issue, we propose a new MoE strategy, DirMixE, which assigns experts to different Dirichlet meta-distributions of the label distribution, each targeting a specific aspect of local variations. translated_title: DirMixE：利用层次化标签变化实现测试无关的长尾识别
translated_abstract: arXiv:2405.07780v3 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：本文探讨了测试无关的长尾识别，这是一个具有挑战性的长尾任务，其中测试标签分布未知且任意不平衡。我们认为这些分布的变化可以按层次分解为全局和局部两个层面。全局变化反映广泛的多样性，而局部变化通常源于较温和的改变，往往集中在特定邻近区域。传统方法主要采用专家混合（MoE）方法，针对少数具有显著全局变化的固定测试标签分布。然而，局部变化未被考虑。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种新的MoE策略，即DirMixE，它将专家分配给不同的标签分布狄利克雷元分布，每个分布针对局部变化的特定方面。此外，这些狄利克雷元分布之间的多样性固有地捕捉了全局变化。
tldr: 本文提出DirMixE方法，通过将专家分配给不同的狄利克雷元分布，同时处理长尾识别中标签分布的局部和全局变化，从而应对测试无关且任意不平衡的标签分布挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DirMixE, which assigns experts to different Dirichlet meta-distributions to handle both local and global label distribution variations in test-agnostic long-tail recognition, addressing unknown and arbitrarily imbalanced test distributions.
